visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all twelve final portable frames against the official nomination measured plans/elevations and its original exterior, entrance and ten inscription-panel photographs. Whole tapered ten-flanged shaft, 52.844 m cone tip, two bands, corbelled neck, closed roof-light recess, deep pointed outer entrance and inner wood door remain. The original solid circular base hid the access steps; the reviewed source exposes both by replacing it with a thin pavement datum and extending the shaft base. Entrance cells were initially detached; the final continuous brick spandrel now contains three closed proportional niches and attached stepped ornament. The ten distinct relief-stroke patterns represent the cited panels, with explicit epigraphic and damage limits.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Actually inspected all twelve final shared-material frames, including four full angles, entrance, cornice, roof light, full silhouette, inscription detail, inner niches, shaft and flat placement fixture. Two canonical 256 px graphs provide brick and wood with metric repeats; both brick wall and roof reuse the same graph. No private or embedded bitmap exists. Relief uses the same shared brick with pale vertex tints. Each graph resolves once and eviction disposes the model with zero live geometries. Regular running-bond courses, cone UV seams and averaged grain are shared medium-fi treatments rather than an exact historic brick bond; the small inscriptions remain relief rather than a photo decal.

mediumFiReview.notes: Actually inspected all 28 final viewer frames after the last entrance repair and focused tests: economy/high quality, noon/late light, full district and skyline, seven source detail cameras, four selected derivative details and four transitions. Every level retains the whole shaft, ten flanges, cone, pointed entry, two-step approach, both bands and closed roof light. Skyline averages ornament and has a coarser cone; district retains distinct flat relief strokes and the continuous inner spandrel. Street/closeup retain physical relief depth, paneled pointed door and three recessed entrance cells. The final cells are integrated with surrounding brickwork. Far colors use the actual linear averages of the canonical graphs, keeping the near/distant palette consistent. Synthetic neighboring houses are a rendering fixture, not a regional architecture claim.

geographicReview.notes: Published nomination pages 66–67 identify the east entrance, giving heading pi/2 for native +Z east and +X north. Actual north-up Google satellite pixels show the tower centrally on its mound with eastward park approaches; a missing eastern tile and roof/shadow prevent a finer door survey. Retained Q606763 and OSM way 328041889 identify approximate center [55.169013207,37.258093443]. The closed 65-point map frame is an original measured-envelope base circle, not a fresh OSM geometry download. Cardinal orientation has approximately ten degrees reconstruction uncertainty. Ground0 is the mound summit and requires real host terrain to provide that summit; no arbitrary ten-metre elevation offset is added. The flat fixture verifies the signed transform and disables footprint replacement, while exact mound/DEM fitting remains unmeasured.

fidelityReview.notes: The unchanged original heritage recipe reproduces exact cb3f9fef2179d6773d196d09a882d9c306714d6d199c6dfb70bd06a6a364e112 source bytes. A separate source-local reviewed master preserves the measured 36.971 m shaft and 15.873 m cone, ten right-angle flanges and principal apertures. Both bands include ten individual original stroke interpretations after nomination figures 67–76. These are not a certified readable transcription; upper/lower sequences reuse the same interpreted shapes, while letter damage and plaster are averaged. Entrance spandrel, niche/cross proportions, wood infill, 2 cm pavement datum and cone-light splay are reconstructed. Scan-table anomalies, exact mortar/bonds and weathering are averaged. Hidden chamber, buried foundation, park paths/ramps/furniture and terrain mound are excluded. The nomination itself rejects an assumed simple double-shell roof; no fabricated interior roof geometry or renewed maximum-fidelity approval is implied.

Three focused checks pass exact original draft reproduction, published cardinal placement, attributed closed measured-envelope frame, all ten tapered flanges at every level, complete 52.844 m tip, ground0, ray-tested deeply recessed opaque entrance, closed roof light, exposed lower approach step and physical side niche. Byte-identical forced regeneration passes triangle/draw/download ceilings, two shared graphs and separate 12-byte POSITION/NORMAL buffers. Strict medium-fi and pinned derivative checks pass. All 52 final images were actually inspected after relevant builds.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Reviewed source has 12469 triangles and 1039616 bytes; its runtime import has 1039164 bytes. Skyline/district/street/closeup contain 786/3273/8845/12469 triangles with 61788/220672/626712/826952 bytes and at most four draws. Initial transfer is 282460 bytes, below the 3 MB phone and 6 MB laptop targets. All near levels reuse two canonical material graphs; far palette uses their actual baked linear means. Separate attribute streams avoid duplicated GPU uploads. Historical detailed source remains reproducible. Physical phone/laptop timings and exact host mound terrain contact remain separate unmeasured work.

limitations: Complete static medium-fi exterior; original detailed draft remains reproducible. Ten tapered right-angle flanges, pointed east entrance, two steps, recessed wood inner door, three proportional brick entrance niches, ten distinct relief-stroke panels per inscription band, corbelled neck and closed roof light remain. The 52.844 m tip follows the 2010 laser scan rather than the erroneous 72 m OSM tag. Curved bays and cone interpolate measured sections; anomalous scan-table diameters are averaged. A thin 2 cm circular pavement datum corrects the original 40 cm disc that hid the two access steps; the pavement thickness and inner spandrel/niche/door geometry are approximate, not a conservation survey. Relief strokes interpret nomination figures 67–76 individually but do not certify a readable epigraphic transcription; upper and lower bands reuse that sequence, while exact letter damage and plaster are averaged. Roof light retains the published height and base datum with approximate splayed width and reveal. Hidden roof construction and chamber are excluded from this exterior scope; the nomination itself rejects a simple assumed double-shell construction. Mound, park paths, ramps, furniture and buried foundations are separate terrain/site context. Host terrain must supply the mound summit; no fixed 10 m offset is added atop unknown terrain. Retained exact-QID OSM center is approximate. Published east entrance gives cardinal orientation with about 10 degrees uncertainty, not surveyed azimuth. Footprint replacement is disabled.
